description:
Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') vulnerability in Akıllı Ticaret Software Technologies Ltd. Co. E-Commerce Pack allows Reflected XSS.

This issue affects E-Commerce Pack: through 2026-10-06. NOTE: The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
